changes_made.explanation: Consolidated duplicate dataset descriptions and removed overly specific/redundant entries. Kept only the main task (Text Summarization) and core models mentioned (LLM, T5).
No automatic metrics are used in the paper. The paper describes LLM workflows but does not evaluate generated outputs with automatic metrics.

The paper mentions LLMs as judges as an example workflow type that DataDreamer supports, but does not actually conduct any LLM-as-judge evaluation in the paper itself. The extracted metadata incorrectly suggests the paper uses LLMs for evaluation when it only describes this as a supported workflow type.
No human evaluations are conducted in this paper. The paper introduces a tool for LLM workflows but does not include any evaluation of generated outputs.

overall_notes: This paper introduces DataDreamer, a tool/library for implementing LLM workflows, but does not conduct any actual evaluation of NLG outputs. The paper describes various workflow types (synthetic data generation, LLM-as-judge evaluation, etc.) as examples of what DataDreamer supports, but does not perform these evaluations itself. The extracted metadata incorrectly attributed workflow descriptions as actual evaluations conducted in the paper.
